items.rationale: Covered as reinstatement of damaged wall tiling in the damage area (policy 1.1, 7.1.1(b), 3.5(b)); reference cases show standard tiling work for similar areas is indemnified.
Drilling for pipe pass-through is necessary for reinstatement of the tiled panel (policy 7.1.5); similar minor work is always included in reference cases.
Material for reinstating the damaged area, standard grade (policy 7.1.6, 3.5(a)); reference cases confirm standard tiles are indemnified.
Levelling is necessary where render was lost to water damage (policy 7.1.5); reference cases show such substrate prep is included.

No such tile size exists; likely a mis-entry or refers to offcut/packaging. If these are premium/oversized tiles, policy 3.5(a) limits to standard grade; but as the description and damage show only standard tiles, t = 0.
Silicone joints in the damage area are necessary for reinstatement (policy 7.1.5); reference cases show such work is included.
Only standard-grade materials are indemnified (policy 3.5(a)); if this is an upgrade, indemnity is capped at standard silicone price for the necessary length.
First vehicle/call-out charge per contractor per document is covered (policy 7.4.2); reference cases for tiling show 65–83 is fair.
Labour for necessary reinstatement in the damage area is covered at local rates (policy 7.4.1); reference cases for similar trades show 18–28/hr for skilled, so 14×22=308.

items.description: Clean wall tile covering 1 flat rate
items.rationale: Cleaning of reinstated surfaces in the damage area is part of the repair (policy 3.5(c)); reference cases show this is included if not excessive.
Removal of wet plasterboard boxing adjacent to the damage is necessary (policy 7.1.5); reference cases for similar removal work show this is covered.

items.description: Removal and disposal of damaged insulation 1 pcs
items.rationale: Removal/disposal of wet mineral wool from the boxing is necessary and covered as part of debris removal (policy 5.2.1, 7.1.5); reference cases support this.

items.description: Remove damp plaster in basement rooms 3 m²
items.rationale: Removal of damp render behind the damaged tiling is necessary for reinstatement (policy 7.1.5); reference cases for similar work show this is covered.

items.description: Remove damp plaster in attic 1 pcs
items.rationale: Attic staining is pre-existing and unrelated to the insured event (policy 3.5(b)); reference cases exclude such maintenance.
Replacement of the chrome cover ring (wall rosette) broken during necessary repair is covered (policy 7.1.5); reference cases for similar small parts show this is included.
Disassembly/reassembly of pipe joint and fittings is necessary for repair (policy 7.1.5); reference cases for similar work show this is included.
Drying of the affected area is covered as technical drying (policy 5.2.7); reference cases for 7-day dryer rental are 58–84, so 70 is fair.
Flat-rate surcharges are only covered if attributable to necessary materials (policy 7.4.4); reference cases show small parts/consumables at 33–45, so 35 is fair.
Replacement of sodden lagging is necessary for reinstatement (policy 7.1.5); reference cases for 1 m are 19–22.
Disposal of debris from the repair is covered as debris removal (policy 5.2.1); reference cases for similar jobs are 57–61.
